content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) for an ANRF sanctioned research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and additionally Project Associate-I positions based on project requirements.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled-in online application form is 11-10-2026. Candidates should apply before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech./M.E. or B.Tech./B.E. in Mechanical, Chemical, or Computer Science & Engineering with at least 60% marks throughout.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years, with applicable age relaxations provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of INR 37,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to submit their forms through the official application portal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online or offline interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can apply online by visiting the official IIT Jammu application portal at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home before the deadline.
